hypotheses.N0_native_channel_sum_is_exact: All 4,608 native channels reconstruct every local bilinear derivative with fidelity at least 0.999999.
hypotheses.N1_static_512_channels_are_sufficient: A discovery-frozen 512-channel bank retains at least 0.80 local derivative fidelity at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.N2_static_1024_channels_are_high_fidelit: A frozen 1,024-channel bank retains at least 0.90 fidelity at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.N3_ranked_channels_beat_random: At 512 channels, the frozen bank exceeds the matched random-bank 95th percentile by at least 0.10 at every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.N4_context_specific_channel_selection_is: At 512 channels, the per-example oracle exceeds the frozen bank by at least 0.05 for at least one layer/corpus.
hypotheses.N5_static_bank_transfers_ood: At 512 channels, each OOD fidelity is within 0.05 of FineWeb at every layer.
hypotheses.N6_native_neuron_sparsity_is_sufficient: Every layer and corpus reaches 90% fidelity with at most 512 of 4,608 channels.
hypotheses.N7_some_local_operators_are_broad: At least one layer/corpus remains below 90% fidelity with 1,024 channels.
hypotheses.N8_factor_swap_is_invariant: Swapping every native channel's Left and Right factors changes the reconstructed derivative by relative error at most 1e-6.
